root_cause.text: In the `vsock_update_buffer_size()` function, the buffer size clamping logic incorrectly applies the maximum size limit before the minimum size limit, enabling the minimum check to overwrite the maximum constraint when the configured minimum exceeds the maximum.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff moves the `if (val > vsk->buffer_max_size)` block below the `if (val < vsk->buffer_min_size)` block, addressing the CVE description which states that the original order allowed "the minimum check [to] override the maximum check, inverting the constraint" and caused `vsk->buffer_size` to grow beyond `vsk->buffer_max_size`.
